newsitem.title: INDIA: Gramophone Company of India 96/97 net at 38.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Gramophone Company of India 96/97 net at 38.5 mln.

text.p: The Gramophone Company of India Ltd posted a net profit of 38.5 million rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) compared with 38.6 million rupees in the previous year, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported on Friday.
The newsagency said the company has announced a 10 percent dividend for 1996/97.
The company's gross profit rose to 55.4 million rupees in 1996/97 against 48.0 million in the previous year, the PTI said.
PTI said company's sales and licence fees was 903.4 million rupees in 1996/97.
It did not give any comparative figure.
